pages.text: Server-side checks reject dead, spectator, fake or unloaded players. Skill and ordinary-wave packets have separate budgets. Wave caps, lifetime and range remain bounded. Disconnect and dimension changes clear waves/parry state; respawn resynchronizes resources. Particle budgets apply per chunk/tick, low-effects mode reduces counts, and decorative wave stars are skipped beyond48 blocks.
$(bold)network.* / effects.*$()$(br2)Use /astral help for controls and /astral stats for counters. Restart the world after configuration changes.
